If you have a round that isn't chambering properly, clear it and try again. Smashing it into the chamber will likely not work, and you will likely have to mortar the gun to get it back out.

If you are having constant issues chambering rounds, you likely have a debris or lubrication issue, and again, forcing chambering is likely going to lead to more issues than it solves.
